snippet.title: GTA 6 Strip Clubs Have a NO REFUNDS Sign 💀 #GTA6
snippet.description:
GTA 6 strip clubs literally have a NO REFUNDS sign. And that's just detail 1 of 4: an under-21 notice at the door, the Obey Tailgater S that's basically an Audi, and an Ammu-Nation where buying a rifle is fine… but parking? Customer parking only.

Is GTA 6 too realistic? YES or NO 👇

Status: everything shown is real in-game footage, captured by Mile Zero on PS5. Signs and car badge exactly as they appear in the game.
Images: my own GTA VI gameplay (PS5). Graphics: original by Mile Zero. Voice: AI-generated.

Independent fan project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.
